description: This line plot illustrates the training loss over time for two models, “Vanilla” and “SepLLM,” as they train for up to 250,000 seconds. The x-axis represents “Training Time (s)” on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 250,000 seconds, with tick marks at intervals of 50,000 seconds. The y-axis represents “Loss,” also on a linear scale, ranging from 2.40 to 2.75. The “Vanilla” model is represented by a purple line with triangle markers and a dashed line style, starting at a loss of approximately 2.75 and decreasing to about 2.47. The “SepLLM” model is represented by a red line with circular markers and a solid line style, starting at a loss of approximately 2.75 and decreasing to about 2.46. A green dashed horizontal line is drawn at a loss value of 2.45. A green dashed rectangle highlights the region from approximately 200,000 to 250,000 seconds, with an annotation indicating a 1.26x multiplier applied to the loss values within that region.
